name: anonproxy-arbitrage
description: See what the proxy anonymised, and decide. Control surface only: protection stays in the proxy.

anonproxy.socket.markdownDescription:
Path to the control socket. Empty = the one under the state directory, which the launcher prints on start.

It is a **Unix socket**, not a port: a local port would be reachable by the agent itself, and this API returns real values.
